  - `status` Check the status of the job
  - `version` Print current version of the bot
  - `wait` Register an impediment for a job

comments.author: Vatavuk
comments.body: @emilianodellacasa need a little help. The issue specifies that we need to use `Factory Boy` factories in order to fake relationships in IT tests. @amihaiemil @emilianodellacasa Small error in `SecuredView.dispatch_request`:
Instead of : 
```python 
super(SecuredView, self).dispatch_request(self, args, kwargs)
``` 
we should invoke method without `self`, like this:
```python 
super(SecuredView, self).dispatch_request(args, kwargs)
```
